blocks.text: SOP: zone pick path for building 2 dry

This is the working cut for PCF-1104 on November 9, 2023. Marcus Hale asked for a written bound after the current path (Paper pick sheets leftover plus RF, mixed, skip-scan tolerated on slow SKUs) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host wms.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on skip-scan to hit units per hour, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Walk the WMS path. Scan every location. Skip-scan is out. Rate is secondary to a clean tote. I am not restating a hallway yes. skip-scan to hit units per hour is out because October 19 skip-scan hit 412 UPH and packed 7 wrong SKUs. Tasha pulled the wave. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: uph=412, wrong=7, aisles=14, totes=2.1, seconds=8.4, weeks=3, zones=2, skip=1. Sibling tickets PCF-SOP-2023-014 and PCF-1104-QA. I will not reopen skip-scan to hit units per hour in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: aisle-b2.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (01): refuse on skip-scan to hit units per hour, lock is RF path, every location scan, skip-scan out. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-SOP-2023-014.
If you skip a scan because the tote is 'obvious,' we eat the mispick at pack.

What a skeptical lead would try first on wms.pinecrest.internal: the path Marcus Hale actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on rf.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock

blocks.text: RF path, every location scan, skip-scan out Host wms.pinecrest.internal. Ticket PCF-1104. Acceptor Marcus Hale.

I will not claim skip-scan to hit units per hour is impossible at another shop. I will claim we will not do it here. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host wms.pinecrest.internal.

First useful is RF path, every location scan, skip-scan out, not a prettier board or a louder huddle. Marcus Hale sees that slice on wms.pinecrest.internal. If the slice needs a second process, that is a new ticket and Marcus Hale is in the thread. I will not hide it inside PCF-SOP-2023-014.
